name: Brokenheart
overview: Scripture reveals that the LORD is intimately near to those who are brokenhearted and contrite in spirit, offering salvation and deliverance from their troubles. The psalmist assures that God hears the cries of the righteous and responds by healing their brokenness and binding up their wounds. This demonstrates God's compassionate care for those who come to Him in humility and sorrow, providing both comfort and restoration.
